name: Ear Game (Update)
desc:
Welcome to Ear Game! In this game, you are a ape trapped in this storage facility. Your main objective is to escape this horrible place filled with living experiments trying to kill you. Try to escape or hide from them to survive and escape...

This game is still in an incomplete version, so there's a lot more craziness to come!

Credits:
Xeva: the original creator who had the idea for the Ear Game
Me: I created the game in my own style on Roblox
